name: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): Support for Development of Standards and Accreditation/Certification of Ayush Products and Materials in Collaboration With BIS, QCI and Other Relevant Scientific Institutions and Industrial R&D Centres
benefit:
> **Financial Assistance:**

  - Funding up to ₹20,00,000/- per year per organization/institution for the development of standards and related activities.

> **Reimbursable Expenditure:**

  - Salary of contractual manpower engaged in the project.
  - Collection and testing of samples.
  - Training of technical staff at PCIM&amp;H, HPL, NABL, etc., as per approved norms.
  - Office expen
_eligibility_text: > **Eligible Organisation:** - Organizations or institutes engaged in the development of standards for Ayush materials. - Medical, scientific, and standards development institutions, universities, or institutional departments in the government or the private sector. > **Eligibility Criteria:** - Institutions must have adequate infrastructure and technical expertise to undertake standard development activities.
